stories.title: ‘One big family’: Flintshire foster carers on the scheme no other Welsh council offers
stories.summary: Flintshire remains the only council in Wales running the Mockingbird fostering scheme, six years after introducing it, Foster Wales Flintshire said. Foster Wales Flintshire, Flintshire County Council’s fostering service, introduced the scheme in 2020 and said it was the first local authority in Wales to do so. stories.summary: Natural England dropped an investigation into an oil spill from Stanlow refinery after deciding the site’s permit set no limit on oil released, the BBC said, citing internal emails. stories.title: Mynydd Isa Scout leader to lead school repair team in Malawi over Christmas
stories.summary: A Scout leader from Mynydd Isa will spend Christmas and New Year in Malawi leading a team repairing a primary school damaged by a tropical cyclone. Lily, a leader with Mynydd Isa Scouts, has been selected to join a group of 10 Scouts from across the UK and is the only one travelling from Wales.
